content.json:
# Azure CaC Guardrails - Debug and Metrics Dashboard

This dashboard provides detailed insights into the execution of Azure Compliance as Code (CaC) guardrails modules, including performance metrics, error tracking, and troubleshooting information.

---

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.label: Module Name
parameters.query:
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| distinct ModuleName_s
| order by ModuleName_s asc

content.query:
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ModuleName_s == "MainRunbook"
| where ControlName_s == "OverallExecution"
| extend TotalModules = toint(TotalModulesProcessed_d)
| extend SuccessfulModules = toint(SuccessfulModules_d)
| extend FailedModules = toint(FailedModules_d)
| extend ModulesWithErrors = toint(ModulesWithErrors_d)
| extend TotalExecutionTime = todouble(TotalExecutionTimeSeconds_d)
| project TimeGenerated, TotalModules, SuccessfulModules, FailedModules, ModulesWithErrors, TotalExecutionTime
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 1
content.title: Latest Execution Summary

content.query:
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ModuleName_s != "MainRunbook"
| where isnotempty(ModuleName_s)
{%if ModuleName != "value::all"%}
| where ModuleName_s == '{ModuleName}'
{%endif%}
| extend ExecutionTime = todouble(ExecutionTimeSeconds_d)
| extend ErrorCount = toint(ErrorCount_d)
| summarize 
    LatestRun = max(TimeGenerated),
    AvgExecutionTime = avg(ExecutionTime),
    MaxExecutionTime = max(ExecutionTime),
    MinExecutionTime = min(ExecutionTime),
    TotalRuns = count(),
    TotalErrors = sum(ErrorCount)
    by ModuleName_s, ControlName_s
| extend Status = iff(TotalErrors == 0, "✅ Success", strcat("⚠️ ", TotalErrors, " Errors"))
| project Module = ModuleName_s, Control = ControlName_s, Status, TotalRuns, AvgExecutionTime = round(AvgExecutionTime, 2), MaxExecutionTime = round(MaxExecutionTime, 2), LatestRun
| order by AvgExecutionTime desc
content.title: Module Performance Overview
Recent Errors
Execution Time Trends (Hourly Average)
Errors by Guardrail Control

content.query:
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ModuleName_s != "MainRunbook"
{%if ModuleName != "value::all"%}
| where ModuleName_s == '{ModuleName}'
{%endif%}
| extend ExecutionTime = todouble(ExecutionTimeSeconds_d)
| extend ComplianceStatus = tostring(ComplianceStatus_s)
| where isnotempty(ComplianceStatus)
| project TimeGenerated, ModuleName_s, ControlName_s, ComplianceStatus, ExecutionTime, ResourcesProcessed_d, GraphApiCalls_d
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Detailed Module Execution Log

content.json:
## Automation Account Configuration

The following queries show automation account variables and configuration details for troubleshooting.

content.query:
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ModuleName_s != "MainRunbook"
| where isnotempty(ResourceGroupName_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TenantId_g, SubscriptionId_g
| project TenantId = TenantId_g, SubscriptionId = SubscriptionId_g, ResourceGroup = ResourceGroupName_s, StorageAccount = StorageAccountName_s, Locale = GuardRailsLocale_s, CloudProfiles = cloudUsageProfiles_s, PowerShellVersion = PowerShellVersion_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Current Configuration

content.json:
## Troubleshooting Queries

Use these queries for common troubleshooting scenarios:

### Find modules taking longer than 60 seconds:
```kusto
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where ExecutionTimeSeconds_d > 60
| project TimeGenerated, ModuleName_s, ExecutionTimeSeconds_d
| order by ExecutionTimeSeconds_d desc
```

### Check for permission-related errors:
```kusto
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where Errors_s contains "permission" or Errors_s contains "forbidden" or Errors_s contains "unauthorized"
| project TimeGenerated, ModuleName_s, Errors_s
```

### Find modules with high Graph API call counts:
```kusto
GuardrailsDebugMetrics_CL
| where GraphApiCalls_d > 100
| project TimeGenerated, ModuleName_s, GraphApiCalls_d
| order by GraphApiCalls_d desc
```
